description: This PHP source file is part of the SuiteCRM project, specifically for handling the 'MyLeads' view for leads in the CRM system. It initializes and configures a ListView component to display a user's leads with custom header and query settings, and includes access control and localization functionality.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering list views in the CRM, providing methods to initialize, set query parameters, and process list output.

methods.name: initNewXTemplate
methods.description: Initializes the ListView with a specific HTML template and localization strings.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the title displayed at the top of the list view.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Defines the SQL WHERE condition and ordering for retrieving list data.

methods.name: processListView
methods.description: Renders the list view with the given seed bean and identifiers.
